deny_glob.about: Deny Read(**/.env*) only: blocks the examples too.

allow_example.about: Deny Read(**/.env*) + allow Read(**/.env.example). Docs: an allow rule can't carve an exception out of a deny rule.

neg_bare.about: Deny Read(.env*) then Read(!.env.example), the docs' shape (bare names, any depth).

neg_first.about: The ! rule listed first: Read(!.env.example), Read(.env*). Docs: carves nothing.

neg_other_file.about: Read(.env*) in settings.local.json, Read(!.env.example) in settings.json. Docs: carve-out reaches only its own source.

neg_anchored.about: Read(/.env*) (anchored at the launch folder) then Read(!.env.example). Docs: ! carves only path or ./path rules.

neg_ask.about: Ask, not deny: Read(.env*) then Read(!.env.example) in the ask list.

charclass.about: No negation: Read(.env) and Read(.env.[!e]*), a gitignore character class that skips names starting with e.

neg_dir.about: Read(secrets/**) then Read(!secrets/public/**). Docs: a carve-out can't reopen a file inside a blocked directory.

neg_dir_files.about: Read(secrets/*) then Read(!secrets/public.txt): files, not the whole directory.

ask_plain.about: Control for neg_ask: ask Read(.env*) with no negation.

class_bang_x.about: Read(.env.[!x]*): gitignore reads [!x] as 'not x', so it should match .env.local, .env.production and .env.example.

class_caret.about: Read(.env.[^e]*): the regex-style spelling of a negated class.

class_plain.about: Read(.env.[lp]*): a plain class, should match .env.local and .env.production.
